sections: Atomic Layer Deposition of Li x Al y S Solid-State Electrolytes for Stabilizing Lithium-Metal Anodes

figures.caption: Figure 1. a) Schematic illustration of Li x Al y S ALD; b) in situ QCM measurements of Li x Al y S ALD performed at 150 8 C using (LTB-H2S)/(TDMAAl-H2S) = 1:1; c) Arrhenius plot for temperature-depended ionic conductivity measured using a 50 nm Li x Al y S film.
Figure 2. Nyquist plots of a 50 nm Li x Al y S film. Insert shows the equivalent circuit.

Figure 3. a) AC impedance spectra of Li/electrolyte/Li symmetric cells using both pristine Li and Li x Al y S-coated Li after 68 h storage; b) R SEI of Li/electrolyte/Li symmetric cells versus storage time; c) CE of Li deposition/striping in 1 m LiPF 6 -EC/EMC with pristine Cu and Li x Al y S-coated Cu; d) comparison of hysteresis of Li deposition/striping for both pristine Cu and Li x Al y S-coated Cu with Li metal as reference/counter electrodes.
Figure 4. CE of Li deposition/striping in 4 m LiTFSI-DME with pristine Cu or 25 nm Li x Al y S-coated Cu.

Figure 5. Top-view (a,b) and cross-sectional (c,d) SEM images of Li metal deposited on pristine Cu (a,c) and Cu coated with 50 nm Li x Al y S ALD film (b,d). Note that the 50 nm Li x Al y S ALD film is not visible in these images.
